note: Reproducible comparisons run by the guided recalibration (pinets guide). Each case names its source, dataset and independent reference by their case_artifacts names in capabilities.json (hash-checked before any run). The series rules restate the existing contract of tools/tests/test_pine_exec.py (exact concordance of SMA5, PREV and MID; EMA5 against the SMA-seed series within the relative tolerance documented in the known_divergences of ta-ema). A rule is never relaxed to make a new engine pass; a divergence leaves the capabilities STALE and asks for the holder's decision.

EMA5.basis: known_divergences of ta-ema: SMA-seed convention, float accumulation differences of at most 1 ulp at 12 digits
